name: ingest_intel
description: Ingest knowledge from files in jarvis-intel/ folder into Jarvis's memory. Processes .txt and .md files containing network configs, IPs, project details, and technical information. Automatically deduplicates and won't re-ingest the same files.

async.description: If true, start ingestion in background and return immediately (no wait for completion). Use for workflows where you don't need to verify ingestion succeeded.
